project.title: Temporal dynamics of particulate matter-associated microbial communities in broiler houses and pyroinflammatory responses to aerosol-derived lipopolysaccharide in HD11 cells
project.description: This project investigated the temporal dynamics of particulate matter-associated bacterial communities in broiler houses during the rearing cycle. Airborne particulate samples were collected at different growth stages, and bacterial community composition was characterized by 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing to assess changes in aerosol-associated microbiota under intensive broiler production conditions.
